newsitem.title: USA: Tejon Ranch acquires Champion Feedlot.
newsitem.headline: Tejon Ranch acquires Champion Feedlot.

text.p: Tejon Ranch Co said Tuesday it acquired Champion Feedlot, a cattle feedyard in Texas, for $3.5 million.
The company said in a statement the acquisition, which will be accounted for as a purchase, will increase revenues and profits.

"It is anticipated that the acquisition will significantly increase the company's annual revenues and operating profits and be an important, synergistic part of our new five-year business plan," said Robert Stine, president and chief executive officer.
Champion's 1996 revenues were about $15 million. The acquisition is the company's first purchase outside of its principal holdings in California.
